hack.root_cause: Initialisation Error — Zero-Address Trusted Root (Merkle Proof Bypass)
hack.description: Nomad Bridge's routine upgrade accidentally set the zero address as a trusted Merkle root, making every message valid by default — turning a sophisticated bridge hack into a permissionless free-for-all where anyone could copy-paste the exploit tx and drain $190M over 2.5 hours.
